groups.name: Generate possibilities and make your own creative choice

groups.name: Preserve inquiry in family and education settings

groups.name: Learn as a team without losing independent views

groups.name: Look for missing and contrary evidence
groups.rationale: Adds disconfirmation, survey-question quality and direct contact with people affected.

groups.name: Make responsibility and provenance visible
groups.rationale: Covers disclosure, process records, system objectives and who can use collected information.

groups.name: Recognize false authority and misleading feedback
groups.rationale: These are counterexamples, not recommended prompts: personal guesses and flattering feedback are not evidence.

groups.name: Keep human advisers and practise human reasoning
groups.rationale: Explicit transfer sources: actual relationships, arguing a case yourself and low-stakes rehearsal.

groups.name: Protect the thinking involved in making an artifact
groups.rationale: Explicit transfer sources: writing, first-hand experience and evaluation before automating production.
